sourceRoot: Directory containing index.ts, config.ts, tokens.css, components.css and ai/. All paths in this registry resolve from that directory; preserve ai/ when relocating it.

fields.name: radius
fields.note: Pixels. No runtime validation/clamp; use a finite nonnegative value. 0–16 is the workbench range, not a type/API restriction.

fields.name: reducedMotion
fields.note: true additionally reduces motion; false never overrides OS prefers-reduced-motion.

components.useWhen: Save, submit, create, or open an overlay.
components.alternative: Use Switch for a persistent boolean setting; Tabs for related views.

props.name: state
props.note: Caller-owned state; no automatic loading/feedback lifecycle. Loading disables activation and sets aria-busy; success/error do not disable the button.

props.name: iconOnly
props.note: When true, aria-label is required by ButtonProps; provide a nonempty accessible name.

props.name: aria-label
props.note: Required when iconOnly=true, optional otherwise. Not forwarded via the ordinary inherited base; reintroduced by the conditional union.

props.name: children
props.note: Visible meaningful action label, or one decorative icon in iconOnly idle state. State icons replace icon-only children outside idle.

components.inheritedProps: ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> except aria-label, which is reintroduced conditionally. Native form attributes, id, style, event handlers, ARIA/data attributes are accepted; className is appended. No ref prop in ButtonProps.
exclusions: No asChild or href/link API. Caller aria-busy is overridden by state; internal data-state/data-variant/data-size and className are owned by the wrapper.
components.state: state is fully caller-controlled; disabled is also forced while loading.
events: onClick and native button events; connect actions to application logic.
accessibility: Icon-only needs aria-label. Use descriptive visible text otherwise. Decorative icons should be aria-hidden. Set type=submit explicitly for submission.
limitations: No built-in async operation, persistence, retry or automatic transition back to idle.
providers: SystemProvider for styling/configuration; Button itself reads CSS tokens.

components.useWhen: Related dashboard views under one meaningful group label.
components.alternative: Use DropdownMenu for commands; navigation links for unrelated routes (not supplied).

props.name: items
props.note: Unique nonempty values; supply at least one enabled item and valid active value.

props.name: label
props.note: Nonempty accessible name for the tablist.

props.name: value
props.note: Controlled active value; pair with onValueChange updating caller state.

props.name: defaultValue
props.note: Initial uncontrolled value; later defaultValue changes do not reset local selection.

components.inheritedProps: None beyond TabsProps. Radix Root/List/Trigger/Content props are not spread through this wrapper.
exclusions: No orientation, activationMode, asChild, forceMount, id or arbitrary native/Radix prop passthrough.
components.state: value controls selection; otherwise internal state initializes from defaultValue or first enabled item.
events: onValueChange receives selected value; local state also updates.
accessibility: Required label; each item label is a meaningful ReactNode. Radix supplies roles, keyboard navigation, disabled behavior and panel linkage. Test direction-aware arrows and focus.
limitations: Horizontal only, Radix default automatic activation; no routing, lazy data loading, or library enforcement of unique/valid values.
providers: SystemProvider provides direction, density and scoped CSS.

components.alternative: Use Button for a command; an application checkbox may be more appropriate for a form choice (no Tiraz Checkbox).

props.name: label
props.note: Nonempty visible label associated with generated or caller id.

props.name: checked
props.note: Controlled; pair with onCheckedChange.

props.name: className
props.note: Applied to outer field wrapper; style and inherited native props target the Radix button.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.note: Merged with the generated description id, not replaced.

components.inheritedProps: ComponentProps<typeof Radix Switch.Root> minus children/asChild; includes native button/form attributes, style, ARIA/data attributes, events and ref to the button. Consult installed Radix type definitions for the full inherited set.
exclusions: children and asChild excluded; wrapper owns Thumb and label/help markup.
components.state: checked/onCheckedChange controls state; defaultChecked initializes Radix internal state otherwise.
events: onCheckedChange receives boolean, plus inherited native events.
accessibility: Use visible label, unique id if supplied, and description for supporting text. Space toggles. Native required/name/value/form are inherited.
limitations: Not a custom content slot; inspector choices/allowed attributes do not restrict the public inherited API.

components.useWhen: Several actions behind a focusable trigger.
components.alternative: Use Select for choosing one form value; Tabs for related views.

props.name: trigger
props.note: Single focusable trigger accepting injected Radix props/ref. Tiraz Button works; arbitrary custom triggers must forward them.

props.name: items
props.note: Unique ids and meaningful labels; callbacks are per item.

components.inheritedProps: None beyond DropdownMenuProps. Trigger uses Radix asChild; props configured on the trigger element remain its own API.
exclusions: No defaultOpen, modal, side, collision settings, content className, arbitrary native props or Radix submenu/checkbox/radio item API.
components.state: open controls visibility when supplied; otherwise local state starts false. Pair controlled open with onOpenChange updating caller.
events: onOpenChange; MenuItem.onSelect() invokes application action (no event argument in public type).
accessibility: Name trigger and all commands. Arrow keys, Home/End, typeahead, Enter, Escape and Tab dismissal are supported; focus returns to trigger. Preserve early-opening keyboard focus and real hover.
limitations: Nonmodal menu; no nested submenus. Shortcut text is decorative and registers no shortcut. Long content scrolls within available viewport height.
providers: SystemProvider supplies direction and portal container; nested menus inside Sheet portal into Sheet content to remain within modal focus scope.

components.purpose: Show modal details or a focused editing task.
components.useWhen: A detail view or small form without leaving the dashboard.
components.alternative: Use DropdownMenu for a short command list; ordinary inline content for nonmodal tasks.

props.name: trigger
props.note: Single focusable element accepting injected Radix props/ref.

props.name: title
props.note: Meaningful dialog title.

props.name: description
props.note: Meaningful dialog description; do not omit or pass an empty string just to satisfy the type.

props.name: closeLabel
props.note: Nonempty accessible name for close icon.

props.name: side
props.default: right in RTL, left in LTR

components.inheritedProps: None beyond SheetProps. Radix Dialog props are curated, not spread.
exclusions: No defaultOpen, modal=false, asChild, content className, native attrs or custom focus-event passthrough.
components.state: open/onOpenChange controls visibility; otherwise Radix internal state starts closed. Draft save/cancel semantics belong to the application.
events: onOpenChange for trigger, Escape, backdrop or close dismissal.
accessibility: Required title, description and closeLabel; modal focus management, Escape dismissal and trigger restoration. Keep nested actions within Sheet scope.
limitations: Modal only; width is styled by library CSS. No built-in form validation, data persistence or dirty-dismiss confirmation.
An active Toast can receive Escape first; do not assume every Escape closes this Sheet.
providers: SystemProvider config/portal container; Sheet supplies descendants the current config with its content as portal container.

components.useWhen: Outcome of a completed action; secondary information.
components.alternative: Use persistent inline text for essential errors/instructions, Sheet for a decision needing action. No Alert/Dialog family is supplied.

props.name: label
props.note: Localized notification/viewport label used by Radix.

props.name: closeLabel
props.note: Nonempty localized accessible close name.

components.inheritedProps: None beyond the three provider props. ToastMessage controls individual notices.
exclusions: No public Toast component, open/onOpenChange, provider duration prop, arbitrary Radix attrs or action slot.
components.state: useToast().toast(message) adds an internally managed notice; automatic/manual dismissal. At most three active messages; older active messages are dropped, not queued indefinitely.
events: toast(message): void; message fields described in records.
accessibility: useToast must run in a descendant of ToastProvider (not in the same component before it returns the provider); outside it throws. Place ToastProvider inside SystemProvider. Keep important feedback available persistently too; inspect announcements manually.
limitations: Default duration 5000 ms, info tone; hover/focus pauses expiry. F8 viewport navigation, manual close and down swipe supported. Scoped inline viewport, not a global portal. No guarantee that automated checks prove accessibility.
An active Toast participates in Radix dismissable-layer ordering: Escape can dismiss it before a Sheet even when focus is inside the Sheet. Check layer dismissal and restoration separately.
providers: SystemProvider for styling/config; ToastProvider for useToast callers.

accessibility: Label htmlFor and aria-labelledby target field.id; helper/error and external description IDs are merged. required forwards the constraint and shows a decorative indicator.
limitations: Required indication/error display do not validate application rules.
providers: SystemProvider for shared styling and configuration.
components.purpose: Associate one labeled control with helper and error text.
components.useWhen: Label an Input or Select with persistent application validation feedback.
components.alternative: Standalone Input/Select accepts external native labels or ARIA naming.

props.name: error
props.note: Display only. Application owns validation; nonempty error marks the composed control invalid.

components.inheritedProps: None beyond FieldProps. Render one control using field={control}.
exclusions: No arbitrary-child cloning, validation rules, nested fields or form state management.
components.state: Application supplies error; Field generates stable association IDs.

events: onChange receives React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>; other native input events.
accessibility: Name with Field or native label/aria-label/aria-labelledby. field owns id; caller description IDs are merged. invalid/error supplies aria-invalid without performing validation.
limitations: Application owns validation messages/rules and controlled reset.
providers: SystemProvider for shared styling and configuration.
components.useWhen: Short customer names, emails and other single-line text.
components.inheritedProps: ComponentPropsWithRef<input> except size/type/children. Native editing, autofill, selection, form, style, ARIA/data and typed events are forwarded; React 19 ref targets input.
exclusions: Text-entry types only: no number/date/file/checkbox/radio or multiline API.
components.state: value/onChange controls; defaultValue initializes native uncontrolled value. Native reset restores uncontrolled default; controlled reset needs host onReset.

events: onValueChange(string), including native reset request; native trigger button events.
accessibility: Radix arrows/Home/End/typeahead/Enter/Space/Escape and trigger restoration; disabled options skipped. Name with Field or external label/ARIA. Native required invalid focuses visible trigger.
limitations: Unique nonempty option values and meaningful string labels are caller requirements. Native hidden select supports submission/reset/required; application owns validation rules/messages. onInvalid on trigger does not expose hidden select event. Popup fades without moving hit targets and scrolls within available viewport.
providers: SystemProvider supplies direction/configuration and portal container; nested Sheet supplies its own content container.
components.purpose: Choose a single predefined form value.
components.useWhen: Customer status or another finite single choice.
components.alternative: Input for free text; DropdownMenu for commands.
components.inheritedProps: ComponentPropsWithRef<button> except children/value/defaultValue/onChange/type, plus explicit SelectProps. Native trigger style/ARIA/data/events are supported; ref targets trigger. name/form/autoComplete target Radix native select.
exclusions: No search, multi-select, controlled open, defaultOpen, custom popup/positioning or children slots.
components.state: Radix Select 2.4.1 value/onValueChange or defaultValue. Native form reset restores initial value; controlled owner must accept reset callback. Empty string denotes placeholder.

props.name: duration
props.note: Milliseconds. Supply a positive finite duration. No Tiraz clamp; 1000–60000 is only the workbench editing range.

props.name: config
props.note: When supplied, full required config fields are needed; partial overrides are not merged. Use {...defaultConfig, ...overrides}.

support.purpose: Scope tokens, direction and portal container; accepts no other wrapper attributes. Set lang on a host ancestor above the provider/document so all scoped overlays and notices inherit it.
Typed shared settings, Arabic/compact defaults and paired light/dark accent values; configuration.fields is authoritative metadata.
Returns {config, container: HTMLDivElement | null}. Outside a provider returns defaultConfig/null; CSS styling is not installed automatically. SystemContext is internal, not a barrel export.
Provider props and lifecycle are documented by the toast family.
Returns {toast(message: ToastMessage): void}; use within ToastProvider or it throws. ToastContext is internal, not a barrel export; ToastMessage fields are in records.

conventions.defaults: Default fields contain literal JSON scalars or descriptive expressions. The string undefined means omitted/no default, not a string value to pass. configuration.defaults contains the actual literal defaultConfig.
conventions.authority: Public source/types win; inherited prop details depend on the installed React/Radix versions. Workbench editing limits are not public API limits.
